text: The push that lands ST0031/01 with ST0031/02's bank carries the whole change: tools/ci-state, tools/post-cut, install.sh's install_ci_state and install_ci_jobs, and the tests of each are gone; bin/.devbin/config.yaml's one after: command is `tools/formula publish --pull`, and its gates stay `check all` alone, as hv ruled on 28 Oct 2026 (ST0030); issue Ie8e55e8 is fixed, so menuz names the release asset from one home, held equal to the core's derivation; docs/releasing.md describes the cut at Devbin 0.1.28; and no tracked file outside bin/.devbin, CHANGELOG.md and intent/ names tools/ci-state, tools/post-cut, install_ci_state or install_ci_jobs.
